description: This PHP file defines a final class 'Log' within the AWS\CRT namespace, providing static methods for configuring and issuing log messages to various output streams, such as stdout, stderr, files, or custom streams. It also defines log level constants.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A final class providing static methods for logging at various levels and to various output streams.

methods.name: toStdout
methods.description: Configures logging output to standard output (stdout).

methods.name: toStderr
methods.description: Configures logging output to standard error (stderr).

methods.name: toFile
methods.description: Configures logging output to a specified file.

methods.name: toStream
methods.description: Configures logging output to a custom stream resource.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a message at a specified level.
